main_text.p: vel æde [?] publica, sed intra privatos parietes) similiter act.16.40. legitur, quod Paulus & Silas, postea quam e-gressi essent e carcere, introierint ad Lydiam, &, visis fratribus, consolati sint eos &c. Qui plura desideraverit, consulat locum de cruce, atq; afflictionibus ecclesiæ, & piorum.
main_text.head: REFUTATIO OBJECTIONUM
main_text.p: Objiciunt pontificii: 1. Ejusmodi ecclesias destitui vera ecclesiarum forma. Resp. Destituuntur quidem publica & verbi prædicatione, & sacramentorum administratione, quæ in publicis & apertis locis fit, sed tamen non prorsus sine publico, hoc est communi coetu. at an putabis ecclesiam, nulla apparente forma, quam pontificii stultè admirantur, constare non posse? apage illas næuias: quam namque existimas resplenduisse formam, quum Helias se solum relictum deploraret? quamdiu ab adventu Christi defor-

page.notes: Uncertain: "æde" in the first line (possibly "ædè" or "aede") is marked [?]. The italic "act." reference is read as printed. The "1." before "Ejusmodi" is a numbered thesis and is kept inline. "næuias" is read as printed (apparent u for v in the original spelling, kept as printed; the spelling rule of u/v applies only in the sense of the word, so it may be "næuias" in print). The strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
